intro.text: Nexscient, Inc. (“Nexscient” or the “Company”) was incorporated in the State of Delaware on March 14, 2023. The Company is an emerging-growth company that’s building a global collaborative network of AI-enabled Intelligent Enterprise Solutions and technologies through internal development, synergistic acquisitions, and capital investments in companies involved in machine learning and artificial intelligence technologies. As part of its growth strategy, the Company also seeks to acquire and integrate synergistic AI and machine learning companies and technologies into our collaborative network, further expanding its service offerings while enhancing shareholder value. The Company’s headquarters are in Los Angeles, California.
